source_reviews.finding: A band location is relative, not a standalone reversal instruction. Trending price may remain near a band; outside closes can imply continuation. Complementary evidence should not merely duplicate the same information. Default parameters are not universal, standard deviations do not establish a normal-return probability, and small bars still need adequate activity. These are usage principles, not an economic certificate for this implementation.

source_reviews.reviewed: complete available toolkit description and author's Method IV note
source_reviews.finding: This platform's Method IV requires low relative volatility and an inside-close/outside-close/subsequent-extension sequence, with a stricter high/low alternative. It differs from the TradeStation manual's description. Pin exact source/platform rules before any reproduction; the toolkit is not a complete trading system by itself.
